title: Check Out Our Joyful Treetop Escape Loft | Rosemary Beach in Florida Rental – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Plan a trip to Rosemary Beach and book this gorgeous penthouse condo! Our Treetop Escape Loft has the perfect location for you to create all kinds of experiences. Click here!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

This luxurious, coastal chic penthouse condo is the perfect fit for your Rosemary Beach getaway.

Situated ideally in the heart of Rosemary Beach overlooking North Barrett Square, Treetop Escape is just a moment away from all of the shops, restaurants and sugar white sand beaches of Rosemary Beach. A 2-3 minute walk along one of the shaded boardwalks will bring you to one of Rosemary Beach's 4 stunning community pools (one indoor and heated), salon, day spa, Fitness Center and Racquet Club.

No worries about flights of stairs here! Enter the Lofts West building through our secure lobby entrance and take the elevator to this stunning penthouse condo. A travertine tile foyer leads into the open concept living/dining area where a soaring 20 ft vaulted ceiling and clerestory windows fill the space with light and volume that you will not find in other properties.

A fabulous, fully stocked chef's kitchen complete with granite counter tops and stainless appliances is perfect for preparing a gourmet meal or just a snack before hitting the beach. For your convenience, a high efficiency washer and dryer are provided in the kitchen pantry/laundry room.

Just off the kitchen and beyond the breakfast bar (with seating for three) is the elegant dining room which seats 8 comfortably and features a small seating area ideal for relaxing with a book or catching up with family and friends.

Distinctive designer furnishings and creative touches fill the comfortable and open living area. There's plenty of seating for everyone! Relax on the down-filled couches and enjoy the entertainment system featuring a large flat screen TV, DVD player and surround sound.

Just off of the living area is the spa-like master suite featuring a 20 ft cathedral ceiling, king size bed ornamented by a Tommy Crow original, walk-in closet, and a large flat screen TV. The spacious master bathroom boasts a soaking tub, large walk-in travertine shower, and double vanity with plenty of storage.

The guest bedroom is large enough to relax comfortably after a day on the beach and features a king size bed, flat screen TV, large closet and a wonderful bathroom with a shower/tub combo.

The furnished balcony off of the living area is the best room in the condo!! It is the perfect spot for morning coffee, sunsets, or just 'people watching' on the square.

*THIS PROPERTY HAS A 4-NIGHT MINIMUM DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER.

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
